meta.summary: TuneYou home page: hero and promo sections, station artwork, charts and podcasts
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, headless Chrome (iPhone UA 390x844 and desktop UA) on tuneyou.com (home page) only; selectors were run on the saved live DOM. Station, artist and player pages were not loaded.

The site is a Next.js app styled with Tailwind, so there are no hashed classes but also few stable hooks. Rules use the main element, href prefixes (/artist/, /podcast/), the Next image marker data-nimg and Tailwind utility names that are part of the visible design (py-16). If the design changes, those utility names can change.

- **Ads**: the page has one ins.adsbygoogle (covered by the generic rule) with an iframe#aswift_0 labelled Advertisement; the new rule matches that iframe by its English aria-label. 1 on both layouts (LIVE).
- **Hero and promo sections**: sections with py-16: the hero banner, Explore Radio Stations and Why TuneYou? 3 on both layouts (LIVE).
- **Artwork** (Show/Blur/Hide): main img[data-nimg], 37 on desktop and 58 on mobile (LIVE).
- **Charts**: the section containing /artist/ links, 1 (LIVE). **Podcasts**: the section containing /podcast/ links, 1 (LIVE).

The fixed header with Log In and Sign Up is never matched. The mobile page adds regional sections (Stations from your country, Active Chats) that were not given rules. No cookie banner appeared logged out (the generic rule is unverified). Not verified: logged-in views, other countries.
